subject: Casper octopus
topic: More than four kilometers down near Hawaii, a robot found something that looked like a ghost.
script:
More than four kilometers down near Hawaii, a robot found something that looked like a ghost.
A small, pale octopus with almost no color, resting on the seafloor.
The internet nicknamed it Casper, after the friendly ghost.
It was spotted in twenty sixteen by NOAA's robot Deep Discoverer, northeast of Necker Island.
Octopuses without fins had never been reported this deep before.
Scientists say it is almost certainly a species no one has ever described.
It may not even fit into any known group of octopuses.
One dive, one camera, and a brand new mystery.
What would you name it?
